positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description: As a front-end developer, my responsibilities include taking a design and converting it into functioning code using mobile-first best practices. I am also responsible for code management through the use of Git and modular practices such as SMACCS and type-based architecture and VMC. Building user interfaces requires multiple iterations and so I am also responsible for creating deployable builds using automation tools like GruntJS and Capistrano for deployment.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description: Design social announcements for various occasions such as weddings, graduations, baby showers, birthdays, and quinceañeras, in English and Spanish. Design logos, web banners, web pages, bookmarks, and much more.

positions.title: Lead Designer
positions.description: Designed social announcements for various occasions such as weddings, graduations, baby showers, birthdays, and quinceañeras, in English and Spanish. I was also in charge of printer maintenance, supplies, and color management.

projects.title: Fees 4 Us
projects.description: Responsible for styling and adding functionality to Ruby on Rails templates based on UX design mockups. Deploying to live site using Capistrano and Git. Incorporating internationalization to templates for bilingual functionality.

projects.title: Find Help Phoenix
projects.description: A single page application where I learned to build responsive web UI with AngularJs using APIs, Bootstrap and NodeJs. The application is targeted towards residents of the Maricopa County in Phoenix, Arizona and its supposed to provide the user with a list of public services near their neighborhood based on their search terms.
